Escalation and Stop RulesLink

TriggerRequired ActionFounder Rationale
Backup-source coverage weakens or remains below 70% after the next review cycleKeep Golden Harvest active only under controlled dependence and refresh mitigation queue.Fallback weakness should not be disguised by good primary execution.
Golden Harvest concentration rises above the current 36% sourcing shareMove the decision into concentration review before new commitments are accepted.Supplier success can create fragility if it concentrates too quickly.
Peak packing-slot confirmation slips past 2026-05-09Pause widening of garlic commitments until slot proof is restored.Capacity confidence must be current before customer promises expand.
Sunrise Agro qualification expansion misses the 2026-05-28 targetTreat garlic fallback as partial standby only and update the risk register.A named fallback without release-ready volume is not a resilience answer.
Supply-disruption recovery window remains above 10 daysKeep founder review on any high-value or time-sensitive garlic commitment.Recovery timing still exceeds operating risk appetite.
Promotional spot demand appears before a fallback playbook existsRoute the decision to scenario review before accepting the order.Unhedged spot demand can consume capacity that the core program needs.

End-of-Cycle CloseoutLink

Closeout TestRequired EvidenceCloseout Standard
Capacity proofUpdated Golden Harvest slot confirmation and refreshed capacity coverage metricExport capacity coverage reaches 120%+ or is accepted as a founder exception.
Backup proofSunrise Agro qualification expansion and updated fallback-volume countBackup-source coverage moves toward 70%+ with clear release conditions.
Concentration proofUpdated portfolio concentration readingGolden Harvest sourcing share trends below 25% or has an explicit mitigation path.
Recovery proofUpdated disruption recovery windowRecovery window moves below 10 days or is escalated with a dated owner.
Trust proofUpdated trust posture matrix and supplier performance scorecardSupplier remains controlled until resilience metrics justify a higher tier.
